name: F.I.S.H.W.L.E.G. A Date w/ Jean-Nette
source:
Play as Poppy, and let your unease settle as you chat with Jean-Nette, testing the waters for a deeper relationship. Will your burning passion for your fishy friend prevail? Or will your fantasy go up in smoke?

[From [url=https://bubbblehoney.itch.io/fishwleg]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演Poppy，在与Jean-Nette聊天时缓解你的不安，尝试建立更深层次的关系。你对你的可疑朋友的炽热热情会占上风吗？或者你的幻想会化为泡影？

[来自[url=https://bubbblehoney.itch.io/fishwleg]itch.io[/url]]
